pairs.locus: Iacobus de Voragine, Historia de sancto Thoma apostolo
pairs.question: Quid comparare vis, iuvenis?
pairs.answer: Dominus meus misit me, ut conducam servos in arte architectoria eruditos, ut Romano opere sibi palatium construatur.
pairs.derivation: The Lord (Dominus) asks the praepositus what he wishes to buy; a genuine interrogative (Quid... vis?). The reply directly states his commission. Stripped the speech tag 'Cui ille:' before the answer; the question already stands alone within its quotation marks. Answer ends at the full stop; the following sentence ('Tunc Dominus tradidit ei Thomam...') is narration, not part of the reply.
